ops.title: binrun read-version-file error on a Mac without ~/Applications/Captain Hook.app
ops.body:
Anubhav's Mac (Oct 20, 10:56 AM) prints `PostToolUse:Bash hook error: binrun: read version file: open <home>/Applications/Captain Hook.app/Contents/Info.plist: no such file or directory` on every Bash call.

Mechanism: plugin bin/hook -> scripts/install-binary.sh -> binrun v0.8.0 bin/hook.binrun (kind signed-app, version.file = ~/Applications/Captain Hook.app/Contents/Info.plist). daemonkit v0.31.0 artifact.Store.Resolve calls ResolveVersion before resolveSignedApp, so a missing bundle surfaces as the raw `artifact: read version file` error instead of the ManualUpgradeError ("signed app is not installed; run ...") that attestSignedApp would return. Non-guarded events (PostToolUse etc.) exit 1 with that text; guarded PreToolUse/PermissionRequest already take the skip-note path. The `~` in the pasted error is the redacted home (expandHome resolves through passwd), so the app is simply not deployed: the formula installs the app into its Cellar libexec and only `uvx capt-hook helper install` deploys ~/Applications/Captain Hook.app.

The requested "fall back to the CLI's own version / cached tool dir" conflicts with the documented design (docs/guide/troubleshooting.qmd "The signed host is missing or dispatch fails": dispatch exits non-zero instead of falling back to an unfenced wheel). With no app there is no host daemon; non-mandatory events never evaluate locally, and a cached exec copy under ~/.daemonkit/cache would skip signed-app attestation. capt-hook.binrun (MCP/CLI) reads the same plist and fails the same way.

Options returned to root: (A) bin/hook pre-checks the bundle with a shell stat and prints one actionable line naming the path and `uvx capt-hook helper install`, exit 1, guarded events unchanged; (B) A plus a one-shot background `capt-hook helper install` when the Cellar copy exists; (C) upstream daemonkit maps a missing signed-app version file to ManualUpgradeError with a descriptor-named remedy, released through daemonkit -> binrun -> cc-skills pin -> captain-hook.
